importantLimitations: All labels, classifications, and whole-stair boxes are neon-proposed and have NOT been independently verified by a human reviewer; this dataset is NOT training-ready.

Partial candidate-driven annotations (160 FloorCAD detections + 1 known missed S280) CANNOT serve as exhaustive negatives for training: unproposed floor regions were not exhaustively audited, and additional unproposed stairs were visibly observed in crop margins (e.g., S271 STAIR on SW3-F2-p1, stair west of 2908 COMM on SW3-F2-p1, and upper-left stairs near washrooms on SW3-F3-p1 and SW3-F4-p1).

In floorcad-tiled.json, the field named sourceSha256 matches the rendered full.png SHA-256 (index.json full.sha256) across all 8 plans, whereas index.json sourceSha256 stores the source PDF SHA-256. Both hashes were verified and preserved.

Several plans (SE12-F2-p1, SW3-F1-p1, SW3-F3-p1, SW3-F4-p1) use thin stippled CAD raster text where room/stair identifiers are visually fragmented; illegible labels were left empty rather than guessed.
No routing connections, floor-to-floor connectivity, scale, heading, or door accessibility claims are made or inferred.
